newsitem.title: SPAIN: Acerinox posts Q1 net 7.25 bln, outlook "excellent.
newsitem.headline: Acerinox posts Q1 net 7.25 bln, outlook "excellent.

text.p: Results for Spain's Acerinox group in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
NOTE - In a statement, Acerinox said "perspectives of production and sale in all the companies of the group are, at least until the summer, excellent with a moderate stainless steel price uptrend."
Acerinox said its consolidated net cash flow rose to 10.47 billion pesetas from 8.20 billion pesetas at the end of March 1996.

The company added this was "highly satisfactory if it is taken into account that stainless steel prices, despite the hikes of the fourth quarter, became 22 percent lower than those of the first quarter".
"The obtained cash flows and results confirm the clear change of trend that began at the close of last year," the statement said.
Full 1996 group results showed net attributable down 56.8 percent to 14.86 billion pesetas, while net cash flow was down 44.6 percent to 23.87 billion pesetas.
In this quarter's results the 23.33 percent sale of a MEXINOX stake is included, the statement added.
Acerinox said it still has a 10 percent shareholding in MEXINOX.
